head: 00ddfc7e177c2bdb289e0ec10fbf7fca9e9824e5
classification_reasons: Blast radius: plugin/gate/checks.py's lesson_and_eval/_supersedes_problem guards gate (e) for every entry_route:incident change on every project that adopts this plugin version; this round's fix is a security-relevant tightening of that check (closing an arbitrary-file-read/quote vector), not a cosmetic change.

The round combines a security fix (supersedes validation) and crash-hardening in a new module (index.py's frontmatter/date parsing) plus an instruction-text addition, each with its own new committed tests -- several independent pieces of changed behavior, not one small patch.

No pre-existing test was weakened; only new tests were added for the new fail cases and crash paths. The new surface (supersedes bare-filename/self-reference/traversal validation, frontmatter field-shape hardening against non-UTF-8 and malformed dates) had no coverage before this round.
attempted: Intent: the three code fixes map 1:1 to the owner's PR review #5452163356 'fix in this round' items (supersedes bare-filename validation; index.py never crashing on bad stale_after/detected.at/non-UTF-8; sdlc-maintain.md also reading '## Unsorted'); nothing drifted from the stated problem.

Spec and plan: spec.md/plan.md already carried the supersedes-shape requirements and fail-case enumerations from the phase-(b) rounds; this fix round's changes are code-level, not spec/plan changes; plan.md's current 'Files that change' section (re-read on disk) already lists plugin/gate/checks.py, tests/test_gate.py and tests/test_lessons.py, confirming the phase-(c) sync commits (b94e362, 00ddfc7) reconciled the file list.

Proof: read diff-e.patch directly. plugin/gate/checks.py's _supersedes_problem (regex ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-.+\.md$, Path(value).name != value, and a self-reference check, all evaluated before any read of the target file, and the 'is unreadable' message dropped the parser's own text so it can no longer smuggle a target's content) correctly closes the vector described in fix-response.md. plugin/lessons/index.py's new _bad_field_shapes, the (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) catch in _read_text, and _month_label/_date_only hardened to return '' instead of raising all match spec.md's requirements. Found the matching committed tests in tests/test_gate.py (fails_on_a_supersedes_path_outside_lessons, _on_an_absolute_supersedes_path, _on_a_lesson_that_supersedes_itself, _when_the_supersedes_target_was_never_retired) and tests/test_lessons.py (a_stale_after_of_the_wrong_type, a_detected_at_with_an_out_of_range_month, a_non_utf8_lesson_file, month_label_and_date_only_never_raise), each of which would fail against the pre-fix code visible earlier in the same cumulative diff. Crucially, re-read evidence/verifier.md on disk: it is now headed 'change 0003, phase (e) fix round, HEAD 00ddfc7e...' and its 'Behavior exercised' section directly calls _supersedes_problem with path-traversal/absolute/self-reference/nonexistent-target/secret-content inputs and index.py build/check with wrong-type stale_after, out-of-range detected.at month and non-UTF-8 bytes, verdict 'matches the plan'. hook-log.jsonl confirms a genuine third Write to verifier.md at 2026-10-08T07:05:14Z, after the fix commits (05:59-06:47Z) -- this resolves the exact gap my previous pass escalated on (a stale phase-(d) verifier.md with no fresh exercise of this round's security-relevant change). test.log/build.log/lint.log are correctly 'deferred to the runner' (not a claim, not missing proof; verifier.md itself names gate-d.json's prior green run and that these three logs are placeholders).

Blast radius: no guardrail file (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, this repo's root sdlc.yaml) in the diff; template/sdlc.yaml and docs/OPERATING_MODEL.md are plugin-shipped content per plan.md's own citation. No sdlc.yaml risk_list item touched.

Policies: the supersedes fix is a real security-baseline-relevant hardening (no arbitrary file content, absolute path, or traversal path can reach the gate's output); no new stored personal/sensitive field added by this round's changes.

Tests: confirmed the new tests target exactly the fixed code paths and would fail pre-fix. No pre-existing test was weakened. The 4 Important findings (second-occurrence rule, proposed CLAUDE.md lines pending the owner) and the iteration-cap note are owner-deferred per review-response.md/fix-response.md and are not re-litigated here, per the task's own instruction.
